existing.value: The authors report a data re-uploading classifier with one-qubit states on a photonic integrated processor, tested on four binary tasks (circles, moons, tetromino and Overhead MNIST ships versus cars). The multi-layer circuit is implemented by computing its overall unitary and setting it on a single Mach-Zehnder interferometer, using a 2 x 2 submatrix of a six-mode chip, with post-selected coincidence statistics. Three layers suffice for perfect classification of circles and moons; on tetromino the test accuracy falls when the number of layers is too high, which the authors attribute to overfitting.
